result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: the promotional banner uses white text on a very light mint-green background, making it nearly illegible.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white against a very light mint-green background, resulting in severely insufficient color contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or change the text color to a dark shade (such as dark green or charcoal) to meet WCAG contrast guidelines.
